weeks.content:
Read aloud short passages; identify consonant blends (bl, cl,
gr, st).

Pronounce words with consonant clusters correctly; identify
and use pronouns (he, she, it, they).

Write about everyday activities using present tense (I go to
school, I eat breakfast).
Read short comprehension passages and answer "where"
Assessment on reading fluency, grammar, and writing.
Use auxiliary verbs (is, am, are) correctly in sentences.
Identify new words in simple stories; use them in sentences.

Write four sentences using past tense verbs (played, cooked,
walked); use commas and full stops.

Simple dialogues expressing present, past, and future actions
(I am playing; I played; I will play).
Read fluently with correct punctuation; copy short sentences
General review of reading, grammar, and writing skills.

weeks.topic: Examination / Closing PRIMARY 3 ENGLISH LANGUAGE SCHEME OF WORK
